title: TRIBE v2
description: A from-scratch Rust/candle inference server predicting per-vertex cortical BOLD activation from text, audio, and image stimuli, visualized live in 3D.

branches.label: Multimodal Encoders

nodes.title: LLaMA-3.2-3B Text Encoder
nodes.description: Encodes free-text stimuli into 6144-dim features on CPU via candle, with an in-memory cache keyed on (text, sequence length) to skip re-running the model on repeats.

nodes.title: Wav2Vec-BERT 2.0 Audio Encoder
nodes.description: Decodes uploaded audio and pools three hierarchical transformer layers into 2048-dim temporal features.

nodes.title: CLIP ViT-L/14 Image Encoder
nodes.description: Encodes uploaded images through a CLIP vision transformer, routed through the model's otherwise-unused video-projector input slot.

nodes.title: On-Demand Weight Downloader
nodes.description: Background job queue streams each encoder's weights from Hugging Face with byte-level progress and hot-swaps the loaded model into the running server with no restart.

nodes.title: Video / V-JEPA2 Encoder
nodes.description: Video input is accepted end-to-end but the V-JEPA2 encoder is not implemented — the server reports it as not loaded and substitutes zeroed demo features.

branches.description: Rust/candle encoders that turn text, audio, image, and video stimuli into feature tensors.

branches.label: FmriEncoder Core Model

nodes.title: Candle Transformer Architecture
nodes.description: 16-layer, 1152-dim, 8-head transformer with partial rotary position embeddings and ScaleNorm, hand-ported to match the exact trained PyTorch checkpoint.

nodes.title: Checkpoint Conversion Pipeline
nodes.description: Converts the original PyTorch checkpoint into safetensors, which the Rust server auto-triggers and loads on first run if missing.

nodes.title: Per-Vertex BOLD Prediction
nodes.description: Produces activation values for all 20,484 fsaverage5 cortical surface vertices per timepoint from any combination of text/audio/image inputs.

nodes.title: Metal/CPU Device Selection
nodes.description: Auto-detects and uses Apple Metal GPU (falling back to CPU), with a warmup pass at startup.

branches.description: Custom transformer, ported from a PyTorch checkpoint, that predicts brain activity from stimulus features.

branches.label: Live 3D Brain Visualization

nodes.title: Per-Vertex Cortical Coloring
nodes.description: Colors a Wavefront OBJ brain mesh using the real per-vertex activation values returned by the model.

nodes.title: Region Label Overlays
nodes.description: Floating 3D region labels with frosted-glass styling and collision avoidance so overlapping labels reposition automatically.

nodes.title: Temporal (TR-by-TR) Playback
nodes.description: A scrubber control steps through per-timepoint regional activation data to animate the prediction over the stimulus duration.

nodes.title: WebSocket-Streamed Prediction
nodes.description: Predictions stream live progress over a WebSocket connection, with automatic fallback to a plain HTTP request if the socket isn't available.

branches.description: Three.js frontend that renders and animates the model's predicted brain activity.

branches.label: Stimulus Input & Prediction UX

nodes.title: Multi-Modal Stimulus Picker
nodes.description: Text, image, audio, and video input modes each have curated example stimuli per neuroscience category.

nodes.title: Drag-and-Drop File Upload
nodes.description: Clickable/drag image and audio drop zones handle file selection and clear/reset state per stimulus-mode switch.

nodes.title: Model Download UI
nodes.description: UI buttons trigger the background encoder-download jobs and show live byte/percentage progress for each optional encoder.

branches.description: Front-end controls for feeding stimuli into the model and interpreting results.
